actions.action: Run grow light 12–14 hours a day on a timer, positioned 6–12 inches above plants
Alternatively move plants outdoors, acclimating with 1–2 hours of morning sun and adding an hour every few days over two weeks
Check whether patches are flat (farina loss) or fuzzy/raised (mold)
Check leaves for softness/translucency or upward-spreading yellowing indicating overwatering
Check whether new growth is still stretched and pale after 3–4 weeks
At next repot, mix cactus soil 50/50 with perlite or pumice
Water by soaking until it drains, only when soil is dry 1–2 inches down or pot feels light
Later cut and re-root leggy stems

reason: The answer's main diagnosis is insufficient light, it correctly explains farina, and its central fix of more light matches what worked, with nothing harmful.
